description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.skins object, which manages loading and registration of skins for the CKEditor rich text editor, including handling skin parts, preloading images, and CSS/JS resource management.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new skin definition with a given name and definition object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific skin part (like 'editor' or 'dialog') for a given editor instance, handling resource loading and callbacks.
